interpretation.plain_speak: The strong margin signal replicated on a fresh phase. Exact margin alone and the composite-with-margin are almost tied in AUROC; the composite has a small AP edge. We still need a conditional test to prove whether history adds information once exact margin is already known.
interpretation.north_star_question: Confirms continuous margin as a robust native warning signal and narrows the next question to residual temporal information beyond exact margin.
interpretation.next_stage: within narrow preregistered absolute-margin bands on a fresh phase, compare crossing density by temporal state without fitting a new predictor
